authors: Z. Bern, C. Cheung, H.-H. Chi, S. Davies, L.J. Dixon, J. Nohle
title: Evanescent effects can alter ultraviolet divergences in quantum gravity without physical consequences
claim: Evanescent operators (Gauss-Bonnet) and evanescent fields (3-form, dual in 4d) change the coefficient of the two-loop R^3 (Goroff-Sagnotti) divergence of pure gravity and its change under p-form duality, while the renormalization-scale dependence and physical renormalized amplitudes are unaffected and can respect duality.
scheme: Dimensional regularization implied (evanescent operators vanish only in exactly 4d); not named in the abstract.
symmetry_argument: Duality between theories equivalent in 4d; one-loop trace anomaly changes under duality (Duff-van Nieuwenhuizen).

proved: Explicit two-loop identical-helicity four-graviton computation shows the divergence coefficient depends on evanescent content.

red_flags: Generic lesson for DR-based claims: pole coefficients can depend on evanescent operators/fields; only scale dependence (log coefficients) is robust.
notes: Non-SUSY; included as a methodological red flag for DR pole coefficients.
